correctness.rationale: The exterior curvature criterion from Guo–Hu is applied to the exact derivative quotient. Its Cayley transform is w^2(a+3bw)/(1+bw^3). Schur coefficient control gives |a|<=1, |b|<=1/3 before boundary tests, preventing hidden poles. The real cubic 4x^3-3(1+a)x attains its minimum exactly at x=-1 for a<=0 and x=sqrt(1+a)/2 for a>=0. The resulting quadratic inequality has the stated unique nonnegative root B(a), always <=1/4; converses use the maximum-modulus and Cayley maps. Direct differentiation establishes concavity and interpolation stability. The script only checks illustrations.
